subject: Embedded partner: Marketplace certification + IaC acceptance ask
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@asteria.io>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: IaC acceptance + embedded offer certification

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — James and I walked through Redwood’s dedicated runtime and the embedded billing flow, and we’re excited to move forward with a marketplace listing that includes an embedded usage path (our customers consume via our control plane). Before we start the catalog intake, our platform/security teams want two things validated on Redwood’s side:

1) A short IaC acceptance test that proves our Terraform module (we will push to a partner branch) can provision the connector and set the right IAM roles without manual intervention.
2) A checklist confirmation that the listing will support seller-managed metering + co-sell attribution for a sell-with configuration.

We’ve attached our baseline IaC module (iac-template.zip) and a one-page checklist of the marketplace attributes we need (marketplace-cert-checklist.xlsx). Can your team confirm whether Redwood is willing to accept the IaC test harness and the expected metering signals, or is there additional engineering work required?

Timeline: Asteria would like to complete listing certification and a brief technical acceptance test in the first two weeks of June so we can target a July launch.

Thanks —
Priya
Head of Integrations
Asteria Systems
attachments: iac-template.zip, marketplace-cert-checklist.xlsx

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@asteria.io>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: IaC acceptance + embedded offer certification

Hi Priya — really appreciate the clarity and the artifacts. Short answer: yes, we can run an IaC acceptance test and validate seller-managed metering signals, but I want to align on the exact success criteria before we commit the infra QA time.

Quick plan:
- I’ll do a triage with our infra engineering lead (Olga) to validate the Terraform module and identify any missing permissions or provider quirks.
- Ben will own commercial requirements for the co-sell/sell-with attribution mapping so we align SKUs and entitlements.
- Vivek, can you confirm if we need a dedicated listing SKU or whether the embedded offer can map to an existing metered SKU?

Next steps: I’m scheduling a 30-min technical acceptance call for Thursday (May 31) with Olga + James to walk the IaC flow end-to-end. We’ll produce a short acceptance runbook and a pass/fail checklist.

If that sounds good, I’ll send the meeting invite and a proposed test plan later today.

Thanks,
Priom
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@asteria.io>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: IaC acceptance + embedded offer certification

Priya / team —

This looks straightforward from a go-to-market perspective. A few commercial notes so our engineering acceptance test maps to the billing model:

- We need a clear entitlements mapping: either Asteria pushes usage to Redwood under a seller-managed meter (recommended) or we accept a partner-proxied meter that maps to an existing Redwood SKU. The acceptance test should emit a sample usage event and we’ll validate S3/ingest + attribution labels.
- Can you confirm which HubSpot company id we should use for the sell-with entitlement? I’ve linked our HubSpot record in case you want to validate fields.
- If there are any constraints on billing latency for co-sell attribution (e.g., batch vs streaming) flag them upfront — that affects how we validate the IaC test run.

I’ll join the Thurs call. Also looping Ola (engineering) for the acceptance checklist.

—Ben
Director, Alliances (Americas)
Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@asteria.io>, james.hooper@asteria.io
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Marketplace listing: IaC acceptance + embedded offer certification

Thanks for the context — I reviewed the iac-template.zip and ran it in a sandbox. Notes below (short):

- Terraform provider: the module uses a service account pattern that maps cleanly to our partner connector, but it creates a custom role that references an older IAM action (iam.roles.getBinding) that we no longer surface. Please switch to the "redwood.partnerConnector" managed role or provide a role ARN instead of creating a new role.
- Networking: the module expects a direct webhook callback to your control plane on port 443. Our acceptance harness can simulate callback traffic, but we need a stable endpoint and static IP range for the test window (or provide a test proxy).
- Metering signal: add an attribution label named "partner.company_id" and emit a sample event labelled with "hp:67890" so we can confirm attribution mapping.

I’ve drafted a 6-step acceptance runbook and attached it to the invite — the plan for Thursday:
1) Provision using your module against our partner sandbox
2) Validate IAM role and replace if failing
3) Run a simulated usage event and confirm ingestion in the metering stream
4) Verify attribution labels and HubSpot mapping
5) Document any gaps and estimate fix effort
6) Sign off and request marketplace catalog entry

I’ll be on the call at 10:00 PT. Priya / James — please have a dev who can push the module updates (or share a proxy) and a network contact for the webhook test.

—Olga
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: marketplace-cert-checklist.xlsx

From: James Hooper <james.hooper@asteria.io>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jun 2028 14:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: IaC acceptance + embedded offer certification

Thanks everyone — call was productive. Quick summary and commitments:

- We’ll update the Terraform module tonight to reference the managed role ARN you suggested (redwood.partnerConnector) and push to the partner branch.
- Network: we can stand up a short-lived test proxy (proxy.asteria.dev) with a static IP range for the 48-hour window starting Friday.
- Metering: engineering will add the "partner.company_id" label and emit a deterministic sample event with "hp:67890".
- Commercial: we confirm HubSpot company id 67890 (linked) and propose the embedded offer map to new SKU AST-RED-EMB-1. Ben — please confirm if that SKU alignment works or if you prefer mapping to an existing metered SKU.

I’ve attached the signed MPA for the marketplace listing (signed-mpa.pdf) and will send a DocuSign envelope for the final addendum this afternoon.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aiming to close acceptance by Monday so we can start catalog intake next week.

Best,
James
VP, Partnerships
Asteria Systems
attachments: signed-mpa.pdf, DocuSign envelope (noreply@docusign.com)
